sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: No supplied candidate represents the required relationship or result term linking a hull area to its factor or a structural member to the factor used in scantling determination.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Replace the presence-only sh:or with a conditional maximum-selection check: for every structural member linked from the targeted ship that spans at least two hull areas, the hull area factor actually used in that member’s scantling determination must equal the largest factor applicable to its spanned areas. The current second branch merely requires any boundary-spanning member and any unitless ship-level factor, so an unrelated or smaller factor passes; it also does not enforce the rule for every boundary-spanning member. Preserve authoritative ownership and locate canonical terms needed to associate area factors with the spanned areas and identify the factor used for the member’s scantling determination. Do not make the non-boundary case depend on a global all-members alternative.

Replace the presence-only shape with a constraint that, for each ship structural member spanning a hull-area boundary, compares the factors of all explicitly spanned hull areas and verifies that the factor used in that member’s scantling determination equals their maximum. Add required cardinalities so missing members, span evidence, factors, or selected-result evidence cannot pass. The supplied vocabulary does not provide the necessary canonical relationship/result terms linking each hull area to its factor and the member to the factor actually used, so locate those terms with the matcher; do not place or duplicate component-owned facts on the ship merely for convenience.
